changelog:
ta-chart-basics v0.1.0

- Initial release focused on foundational chart-reading and plotting for financial/commodity markets.
- Covers chart types (line, single-line, point & figure), time scales (daily/weekly/monthly/intraday), and arithmetic vs logarithmic scales.
- Explains how to display volume and open interest on charts, with standard reading and plotting procedures.
- Includes clear skill boundaries; not for pure buy/sell decisions or fundamental-only analysis.
- Based on John Murphy’s 《期货市场技术分析》, Chapter 3.
summary: 当用户需要读懂或亲手绘制金融/期货图表、选择时间尺度（日/周/月/日内）、区分线图/点数图/单线图、 或在算术刻度与对数刻度之间做选择、理解交易量/持仓兴趣如何在图上呈现时激活。 不适用于：已会读图只想做买卖决策（转 trend-tools / 形态类 skill）、纯基本面分析。 关键 trigger 词：怎么看K线/图表、蜡烛图、十字星、K线形态、日线周线月线、算术刻度对数刻度、如何作图。 Activate when the user needs to read or draw financial/futures charts, choose time scale (daily/weekly/monthly/intraday), distinguish line/P&F/single-line charts, choose between arithmetic and logarithmic scales, or understand how volume/open-interest appear on charts. Not applicable: already able to read charts and only wants buy/sell decisions (-> trend-tools / pattern skills), pure fundamental analysis. Key trigger words: how to read candlestick/chart, candlestick, doji, K-line pattern, daily/weekly/monthly, arithmetic/log scale, how to plot.
